text:
The response gives a simple definition and useful examples, but its answer to the labeled/unlabeled question is misleading. Standard language models are typically trained on unlabeled text using self-supervised next-word prediction, where the “labels” come from the text itself. Labeled data is more commonly used later for fine-tuning or specific tasks. The assistant says both labeled and unlabeled data can be used without clarifying this distinction, which could confuse a non-technical customer.

Rating: [[5]]
